blurb: Direct logins must not be permitted to shared, default, application, or utility accounts. This check reads the rlogin attribute for the default AIX accounts (adm, bin, daemon, guest, lpd, nobody, nuucp, sys, uucp). If any of those accounts has rlogin=true, that account can be reached over the network. Shared, application, and utility accounts are named by the ISSO/ISSM and are not decided here.
